import csv
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
directory = root / "build_descriptor_reuse/diagnosis"
manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for revision, record in manifest["variants"].items():
    for path in (pathlib.Path(record["build"]) / "_build/Release").glob("*.dll"):
        shutil.copy2(path, directory / revision / path.name)
out = directory / "runs"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
manifest["runs"] = []
samples = {}
for index, revision in enumerate(["before", "after", "after", "before"]):
    name = f"{index}-{revision}"
    exe = directory / revision / "diagnosis.exe"
    command = [str(exe), "--benchmark_min_time=500x", "--benchmark_repetitions=3", "--benchmark_out_format=json", f"--benchmark_out={out / (name + '.json')}"]
    with (out / (name + ".log")).open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=600)
    manifest["runs"].append({"name": name, "revision": revision, "command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "exe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    (directory / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    assert result.returncode == 0
    data = json.loads((out / (name + ".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert data["benchmarks"] and all(not row.get("error_occurred") for row in data["benchmarks"])
    for row in data["benchmarks"]:
        if row["run_type"] == "iteration":
            assert row["draws/frame"] == (300 if "/M100/" in row["run_name"] else 3)
            samples.setdefault((row["run_name"], revision), []).append(row["real_time"])
    print("PASS", name, flush=True)
rows = []
for (case, revision), values in sorted(samples.items()):
    rows.append({"case": case, "revision": revision, "median_us": statistics.median(values), "min_us": min(values), "max_us": max(values), "cv": statistics.stdev(values) / statistics.mean(values), "samples": len(values)})
with (directory / "phases.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
manifest["sha256"] = {str(p.relative_to(directory)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in directory.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix in [".json", ".csv", ".cpp", ".h", ".log"] and p.name != "manifest.json"}
(directory / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2), flush=True)

    shutil.copy2(p, directory / p.name)
manifest = {"method": "Fixed N1000/V3/F3/dirty0; tint uses i%7, so M>=7 has exactly seven material value variants. Measure Compile only, all draws still recorded and submitted.", "runs": []}
samples = {}
for i in range(2):
    exe = directory / "diagnosis.exe"
    command = [str(exe), "--benchmark_min_time=500x", "--benchmark_repetitions=3", "--benchmark_out_format=json", f"--benchmark_out={directory / (str(i) + '.json')}"]
    with (directory / f"{i}.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:

    assert result.returncode == 0
    manifest["runs"].append({"command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "exe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
